title: Firearm Volume 1 #8 (May 1994 Malibu Comics) Ultraverse - James Robinson
descriptionText: The Firearm Volume 1 #8 comic book, published by Malibu Comics in May 1994, features the Ultraverse series written by James Robinson. This US comic book showcases the main character Firearm and is part of a popular series that follows the adventures in the Ultraverse universe. With a focus on action and supernatural elements, this comic is a must-have for fans of the Ultraverse series by James Robinson.
